title: Gravity-weakening experiments with pulsed EM fields

tellings.quote: Uh we got experiments where we uh found we could pulse electromagnetic fields and uh uh get a local weakening of gravity that we could easily measure was like a one part per thousand.

plain: A physicist named John Brandenburg says he and colleagues ran experiments in which pulsing electromagnetic fields weakened gravity in a small area, by about one part in a thousand, an effect he says they could "easily measure." He tells Michels this as someone who took part, in connection with a lab and a meeting of the American Physical Society, the main professional body for physicists in the US. If true, it would mean gravity can be controlled with electricity and magnetism.
